description: The file contains the implementation of an in-memory queue cache (`SimpleQueueCache`) for streaming data in Orleans, including related data structures such as `CacheBucket` and `SimpleQueueCacheItem`. It manages caching, backpressure detection, cursor management, and cache purging logic.

classes.name: CacheBucket
classes.description: Tracks the number of items and cursors pointing to a cache bucket for backpressure detection.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheItem
classes.description: Represents an item stored in the cache, including its batch, sequence token, and associated cache bucket.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCache
classes.description: An in-memory queue cache for streaming messages with support for backpressure detection, cursors, and cache purging.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of cached items.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added at once.

methods.name: SimpleQueueCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with specified size and logger.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is under pressure based on backpressure detection logic.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge oldest items from the cache if conditions allow.

methods.name: DrainBucket
methods.description: Removes all items in a specified cache bucket from the cache.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of messages to the cache.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cursor for iterating at a specific sequence token.

methods.name: InitializeCursor
methods.description: Sets a cursor's position in the cache based on a sequence token.

methods.name: RefreshCursor
methods.description: Updates a cursor's position if it is not set.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message for a cursor.

methods.name: AdvanceCursor
methods.description: Moves a cursor to the next message.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets a cursor to a specific cache node and updates bucket cursors.

methods.name: UnsetCursor
methods.description: Unsets a cursor and updates bucket cursors.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a message to the cache, managing cache size and buckets.
